pairing.hero.title: Send one prompt to your AI. It sets up the rest.
pairing.hero.body: Each computer runs a small program called a node. Your AI coding assistant installs it, verifies it, and connects it. You only copy and paste.
pairing.browser.title: Pairing this browser with your computer
pairing.browser.body: Opened from a pairing link. Check that the fingerprint on the right matches what your computer prints.
pairing.browser.hint: Every browser has its own identity key, stored only on this device.
pairing.prompt.title: Prompt for your AI
pairing.prompt.text:
Please connect this computer to SoloDawn.

1. Read {install} and follow it.
2. Download the node program for this system, and verify its SHA-256 before you run it.
3. Join with pairing code {code}, then tell me how it went.

Ask me before you install anything else or change system settings.
pairing.prompt.text_rv:
Please connect this computer to SoloDawn.

1. Read {install} and follow it.
2. Download the node program for this system, and verify its SHA-256 before you run it.
3. Join with pairing code {code} and --rendezvous {rv}, then tell me how it went.

Ask me before you install anything else or change system settings.
pairing.countdown.min_sec: The pairing code expires in {m} min {s} s and works once.
pairing.countdown.sec: The pairing code expires in {s} s and works once.
pairing.countdown.expired: This pairing code has expired and was discarded.
pairing.howto.label: Steps
pairing.howto.1.title: Copy the prompt
pairing.howto.2.title: Paste it to the AI on that computer
pairing.howto.2.body: Claude Code, Codex, or any AI coding assistant that can run commands.
pairing.howto.3.title: Your AI installs the node
pairing.howto.3.body: It downloads the node, verifies the checksum, starts it and pairs it. It asks you before installing anything else.
pairing.howto.4.title: Come back here
pairing.howto.4.body: The status on the right updates by itself. Then you can create your first group.
pairing.status.title: Connection status
pairing.status.relay_note: If a direct connection fails, a relay takes over (slower, limited data) while the node keeps trying.
pairing.step.node_wait: Waiting for your AI to run solodawn pair
pairing.step.connect_try: Trying UDP, TCP and IPv6 at once. The first that works wins.
pairing.step.ai: Register the AIs on this computer
pairing.error.bad_secret: The pairing code in this link is not valid.
pairing.error.unadopted: The node sent a device log that does not enrol this browser.
pairing.error.not_owner: The node did not recognise this browser as its owner.
pairing.error.lost: The connection to the node was lost before setup finished.
pairing.error.storage: Site storage is blocked in this browser.
pairing.acct.title: How does {name} sign in?
pairing.acct.personal_body: It only takes orders from you. Requests from teammates need your tap each time.
pairing.acct.team_body: You can let chosen teammates direct it.
pairing.acct.api_key_body: Same as team. Usage is billed to the key's owner.
pairing.acct.hint: Not sure? Ask your AI to check how it is signed in. SoloDawn never reads your credentials.
pairing.trust.1.title: Your data stays on your computers
pairing.trust.1.body: Chats and tasks live on the computer that hosts the group. Kept 90 days by default.
pairing.trust.2.title: The server only introduces devices
pairing.trust.2.body: It stores nothing. When it relays, it sees only encrypted data.
pairing.trust.3.title: Open source, self-hostable
pairing.trust.3.body: Apache-2.0. The whole system works without our server.
